messages:
maya: Quick thread  I'm putting together a compact 'Entrance Matrix' for GA of tiered inference. Need fast sign-off from Docs, SRE, Pricing, Support.

raul: Please list the lanes you want checked.

maya: Five lanes: 1) regression & safety gate, 2) SLOs + graceful fallback, 3) telemetry & alerts, 4) customer docs + runbooks, 5) pricing/quota & billing UX. One owner per lane, each with clear pass/amber/fail rules.

tara: I'll own docs/runbooks. Deliverables: 1-pg public Quick Card, internal incident playbook with rollback commands, migration notes for Dedicated/Private, and a short FAQ for prompt regressions.

eli: For pricing: define free-tier caps (throttle text), committed vs burst pricing, preview credits, explicit KV-cache billing behavior, and a clear overage process for Dedicated trials.

raul: SLO proposal: p95 <= 350ms (standard), p95 <= 700ms (long context), global error rate < 0.35% (5xx+timeouts). Degradation rule: sustained p95 > 2x target for 15m -> automatic model variant fallback with traffic shifting.

ops-bot: Note: automatic fallback must have circuit-breaker, audit logging, and a tested rollback path (owner: eng-runtime).

maya: Telemetry expectations: per-model token meter, cost-per-token burn chart, request-id -> trace linkage, and a smoke alert for SLO burn >60% in 5m or error spike >0.5% in 1m. Dashboards must be linkable from runbook.

tara: I'll publish the Quick Card + runbook by EOD and attach to the Entrance Matrix doc. Runbook will include this rollback example:
```
# revert routing weights
redwood route update --from canary --to stable --weight 100
```

eli: Ops asks free-tier QPS <= 10 qps/account with explicit 429 JSON body and billing link. For Dedicated trial, require an overage clause and a manual approval flow for temporary quota increases.

raul: Support plan: Tier 1 playbook in CS + a staffed 72-hour critical rota after launch. Owner pairing: eng-platform + eng-sre.

maya: Gate to GA: all lanes GREEN. If any AMBER, allow staged public rollout (limited traffic + mitigations) with exec signoff. RED blocks go. Specific green criteria: regression smoke pass, SRE 2x-load test within SLOs for 30m, dashboards live, pricing page + billing link live, rota staffed.

eli: Non-negotiables: 1) automated fallback & rollback tested end-to-end, 2) Dedicated trial overage policy signed by finance, 3) customer-facing throttle messaging.

maya: Timeline: if Docs & Pricing signoff today, eng-runtime will wire fallback by Wed, infra dashboards by Thu, load test Fri. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for final go/no-go.

ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled 2025-06-15 02:00 UTC  confirm rota if go.

tara: Ack, will be oncall first 12h post-deploy.

eli: I'll update pricing page and send draft to finance by 15:00.

maya: Thanks team  I'll synth the Entrance Matrix and drop in the launch tracker now. Closing thread.
